title: 1974 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Wood Tiger
seo_title: 1974 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Wood Tiger (23 January – 10 February 1975)
description: 1974 is the Year of the Wood Tiger (Yang, Jia-yin), from 23 January 1974 to 10 February 1975. Personality, lucky colors and numbers, best matches, and what to know if you were born in January or February 1974.
lead: Born in 1974? Your Chinese zodiac animal is most likely the Tiger, but check the date: the 1974 Wood Tiger year began on 23 January 1974. Here is everything about the year, from its element to its lucky colors and best matches.
card_text: 1974: Year of the Wood Tiger, from 23 January 1974 to 10 February 1975.

paras: The Chinese zodiac year 1974 was the Year of the Tiger. It began with Lunar New Year on 23 January 1974 and ended on 10 February 1975, the eve of the next Lunar New Year.

Each year also has an element and a Yin or Yang quality. 1974 ends in 4, which makes it a Wood year, and as an even year it is Yang. In the traditional stem-and-branch count, 1974 is a Jia-yin year. The same Wood Tiger combination comes round only once every 60 years: 1914 before it and 2034 after it.
Lunar New Year 1974 fell on 23 January 1974. Anyone born from 1 January 1974 up to the day before belongs to the previous year's animal, the Ox; from 23 January 1974 on, the Tiger.

The zodiac year starts at Lunar New Year, not on 1 January, which is why early-year birthdays need checking. Our guide Born in January? explains the rule, and the zodiac sign checker gives the exact answer for any birth date.

Our Tiger guide describes the sign like this: “Brave, confident, and competitive. Tigers are natural leaders who act decisively.” The usual watch-out: “Can be impulsive or impatient with slower-moving people.”

The Wood element adds its own flavour. Wood years bring growth, creativity, and a drive to build new things. People of this element tend to be cooperative, generous, and idealistic. Read more in our Wood element guide, or the full Year of the Tiger page.
Careers often linked with the Tiger: entrepreneurship, sports, law, management.

sections.h2: Best matches for someone born in 1974
paras: In traditional compatibility, the Tiger's best matches are the Horse, Dog and Pig, and its clash sign is the Monkey, which sits directly opposite it on the zodiac circle. Our compatibility calculator compares two full birth dates, elements included.
2026 (Fire Horse, until 5 February 2027): for the Tiger, it shares the Horse's triangle, so 2026 is traditionally one of its friendlier years.
2027 (Fire Goat, from 6 February 2027): for the Tiger, it has no special traditional relationship with the Goat, so 2027 is a neutral year. See Chinese zodiac 2027 predictions for every sign.

sections.h2: Other Year of the Tiger years
paras: Years of the same animal come every twelve years, each with a different element: 1950 (Metal Tiger); 1962 (Water Tiger); 1986 (Fire Tiger); 1998 (Earth Tiger). The full list is in our Chinese zodiac years chart.

faq: 1974 is the Year of the Tiger, a Yang Wood Tiger year (Jia-yin).
When does the 1974 Year of the Tiger start and end?
It starts on 23 January 1974 and ends on 10 February 1975.
I was born in January 1974. What is my Chinese zodiac?
If you were born before 23 January 1974, you are a Ox; from 23 January 1974 on, a Tiger.
Wood. 1974 ends in 4, which belongs to Wood, and it is a Yang year.
Who is the Tiger compatible with?
Traditionally the Horse, Dog and Pig. The Tiger's clash sign is the Monkey.
